calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, p.sku,
           f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.standard_cost AS cost
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, p.sku, -r.refund_net, -r.standard_cost_returned
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
by_category_year AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, cp.category, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d     ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = n.sku AND cp.is_current
    WHERE (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 8)
       OR (d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period = 8)
      AND cp.category IN ('Garden', 'Electrical')
    GROUP BY d.fiscal_year, cp.category
)
SELECT category, 
       MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales ELSE NULL END) AS fy2025_26_net_sales,
       MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE NULL END) AS fy2024_25_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0 * (MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' THEN net_sales ELSE NULL END) - 
                      MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE NULL END)) /
             MAX(CASE WHEN fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' THEN net_sales ELSE NULL END), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM by_category_year
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY category;
